messages.subject: Why INLA zeroinflatednbinomial model don't give the part of zero-inflated model (i.e. logit model) ?
parts:
Hello, everyone! 

I want to know why INLA don't give the part of zero-inflated model (i.e. logit model) in the output of zeroinflatednbinomial model, such as Stata give separately the result of count model and zero-inflated model? How can I get that?

Thanks!
